Runtime code/config/tests/active entrypoints outrank generated or historical artifacts.
All audit-pack claims must preserve OBSERVED, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, CONFLICTING, or CLAIMED status where appropriate.

pr.title: chore(rte): assemble gpt-5.5 pro audit pack
pr.body:
## Summary
- assemble upload-safe GPT-5.5 Pro audit-pack artifacts for Repo Truth Extractor review
- crosswalk current prior audit/proof material against runtime source pointers and unresolved drift
- include proof, manifest, upload order, project instructions, pass prompts, and validation baseline

## Scope
- task packet, task-packet index registration, audit-pack artifacts, and proof artifacts only
- no RTE runtime behavior, prompt text, model routing, CLI behavior, tests, schemas, compose files, or canonical docs changed
- no live extraction and no provider/API-key-dependent commands

## Validation
- JSON parsing for task packet, upload manifest, and proof JSON
- task packet schema validation against docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json
- generated artifact existence checks, SHA-256 generation, diff whitespace check, status review, and allowlist path check

steps.task: Preflight repository identity, branch, base branch, marker files, status, and required authority files.
requirements: Record pwd, remotes, status, branch, HEAD, base branch, and repo markers.
Read repo-local instructions and authority files where present; mark missing files UNKNOWN.
Create and verify the dedicated worktree before writes.
validation: Dedicated worktree is on the task branch and not the primary checkout.
Required missing authority files are recorded as UNKNOWN instead of invented.

steps.task: Inspect RTE runtime, CLI, prompt, model, proof, and prior audit surfaces without executing live extraction.
requirements: Map v5, v4, v3, pre-live gate, hygiene, CLI, prescan, promptset, model-routing, proof, and test surfaces.
Inspect prior RTE audit/remediation proof and PR metadata where discoverable.
Do not run live extraction or provider/API-key commands.
commands: rg -n 'repo-truth-extractor|RTE|Opus|audit|pre-live|proof|CRIT|F4' services src docs task-packets proof
gh pr list --state all --search 'RTE repo-truth-extractor OR rte OR extractor' --limit 50 --json number,title,state,mergedAt,headRefName,baseRefName
validation: Runtime and proof surfaces are summarized with evidence paths.
Unavailable or stale evidence is marked UNKNOWN.

steps.task: Assemble the GPT-5.5 Pro audit-pack artifacts and proof outputs in allowlisted paths only.
requirements: Create all requested 00-19 audit-pack artifacts and checksum file.
Update task-packets/INDEX.md only because repo convention explicitly requires packet registration.
commands: python artifact generation script constrained to allowlisted paths
validation: Generated content stays advisory and does not edit runtime behavior.

steps.task: Run safe validation and produce proof-backed final status.
requirements: Run git diff --check and allowlist checks.
Report exact commands, exit codes, dirty state, unknowns, and residual risks.
commands: python -c 'import json, pathlib; from jsonschema import Draft7Validator; schema=json.loads(pathlib.Path("docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json").read_text()); doc=json.loads(pathlib.Path("task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-RTE-55PRO-AUDIT-ASSEMBLY-001.json").read_text()); errs=sorted(Draft7Validator(schema).iter_errors(doc), key=lambda e: e.path); raise SystemExit(0 if not errs else 1)'

python - <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys
allowed_exact = {'task-packets/INDEX.md', 'task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-RTE-55PRO-AUDIT-ASSEMBLY-001.json'}
allowed_prefixes = ('out/rte-55pro-audit-pack/TP-DMX-RTE-55PRO-AUDIT-ASSEMBLY-001/', 'proof/TP-DMX-RTE-55PRO-AUDIT-ASSEMBLY-001/')
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'merge-base', 'HEAD', 'origin/main'], text=True).strip()
diff_paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', f'{base}...HEAD'], text=True).splitlines()
status_lines = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--short', '--untracked-files=all'], text=True).splitlines()
status_paths = []
for line in status_lines:
    if len(line) < 4:
        continue
    path = line[3:]
    if ' -> ' in path:
        path = path.split(' -> ', 1)[1]
    if path:
        status_paths.append(path.rstrip('/'))
paths = set(diff_paths) | set(status_paths)
bad = sorted(p for p in paths if p not in allowed_exact and not p.startswith(allowed_prefixes))
if bad:
    print('forbidden changed paths:')
    print(chr(10).join(bad))
    sys.exit(1)
print('allowlist-ok')
PY
validation: Final status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only if validations pass.
